sonnet.problem: Abram is first mentioned on the opening card with no short label saying who he is. The card only says the LORD promised him land. Every other new person in the passage gets a label (for example 'Melchizedek, king of Salem' and 'Abram's nephew Lot').
sonnet.rule: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader." "The first time" means the first time in this passage. Each lesson stands on its own, so he never says "last time."
